The Matron of Ash
Every long night on every ward, given a voice. It sounds exactly like Ilse on her worst day.
Vigil Knight
Every knight who ever stood the vigil here left a little of themselves in the stone. It stands up to see if you are worthy.
Squire's Shade
The squires who failed the vigil. They are not angry. Only cold.

Scrap Golem
Somebody's stove, somebody's fence and somebody's grandmother's mangle, walking.
Junk Mimic
It is a crate. It is a crate with teeth. Do not open the crate with teeth.
Scrap Rook
It steals buttons, rings, buckles and, given the chance, eyes.
The Rook Queen
Queen of Scrapfall, the best thief in the sky. Until about five minutes ago.
The Squall King
The Stormwall's heart. It has eaten twelve airships. It would like a thirteenth.
Kingfisher Gunner
The Kingfisher's crew never left their guns. Nobody told them the battle was over.
The Forgotten
Someone nobody remembers anymore. It does not remember either.
Gloam Shade
The Gloam, when it tries to be someone.
The Unremembered
Every forgotten thing the Gloam ever kept, wanting one more thing to keep.
The Fallen Star
A star that came too close, to see what all the fuss was about.
